title: Swing When You're Winning
headline: 25 years ago, Robbie Williams sang with the late Sinatra
caption:
Sinatra's world turns up on this album a second time. Bill Miller, who played piano on many of Sinatra's tours and recordings, accompanies Robbie on 'One for My Baby'.

Miller had played on Sinatra's original 1954 soundtrack recording of that song and on his 1958 Capitol studio version. Robbie's album was recorded at Capitol Studios in Los Angeles and came out on the Capitol label.

🎧 Key track: "It Was a Very Good Year" by Robbie Williams (@robbiewilliams)

Source: Robbie Williams's account of the Sinatra duet and the album's recording details (via Wikipedia)
